signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office

bullets: Define key aspects of the product strategy and roadmap for Zipline’s Airspace Platform, spanning airspace intelligence, strategic and tactical coordination, interoperability…
Turn real-world flight and airspace data into products that improve safety, efficiency, visibility, and access to shared airspace.
Build analytical tools and metrics to identify operational friction, explain delays and conflicts, measure airspace efficiency, and guide product decisions.
Lead interoperability with external drone operators, air traffic management, regulatory, and industry systems.
Help shape industry standards and ecosystem architecture through engagement with regulators, standards organizations, customers, and partners.
